name: vito-agent-plugins
description: Vito's personal Claude Code skill collection — planning, clean-context second opinions, context auditing, web/code search, session handoff, and HTML visualization. Bundles 6 skills auto-discovered from skills/, plus 4 companion subagents (agents/) that run the noisy skills in isolated contexts, and PreToolUse hooks that redirect inline skill usage to the corresponding subagent.
